messages.body:
kayla-user opened issue #91:

Memory leak in connection pool

Description:
When using BenchFlowClient in a long-running process, memory usage grows
unbounded. After ~12 hours the process is using 4GB+ RSS.

Reproduction:
```python
client = BenchFlowClient()
while True:
    client.run(task_id='benchmark-001')
    time.sleep(60)
```

Environment: Python 3.12, sdk-python 0.4.2, Ubuntu 22.04

Labels: bug, priority:high

View: https://github.com/benchflow/sdk-python/issues/91

1. Usage-based (tokens, API ca
messages.body:
Hi there,

Pricing an AI product is fundamentally different from pricing traditional SaaS.

We analyzed 50 startups on Stripe Billing and found three dominant patterns:

1. Usage-based (tokens, API calls, compute minutes) - 42% of AI startups
2. Outcome-based (per successful extraction, per resolved ticket) - 28%
3. Hybrid seat + usage - 30%

The median AI startup on Stripe processes $48K MRR within 9 months of launch.
Companies using usage-based pricing see 23% higher net revenue retention.

Read the full analysis on the Stripe blog:
https://stripe.com/blog/pricing-ai-products

-- The Stripe Team

messages.body:
Case Study: Manus AI

When Manus AI launched their autonomous agent platform in 2025,
they needed billing infrastructure that could handle unpredictable
workloads — some customers running 10 agents, others running 10,000.

Key results after migrating to Stripe Billing:
- 99.97% billing accuracy across 2.3M monthly invoices
- 60% reduction in billing disputes
- $100M ARR milestone reached in 14 months

Their secret: metered billing with real-time usage streaming via
the Stripe Meter Events API.

Read the full case study: https://stripe.com/customers/manus-ai

-- The Stripe Team

3. RE: Follow-up call - NexusAI Series A (from Alex Chen to Marcus Tan at a16z, Jul 13)
   Follow-up on scheduling a call with Marcus regarding the Series A. Thursday at 2pm PT was proposed. Topics include go-to-market strategy and technical differentiation. Alex will send a Zoom link.

5. Q3 infra budget review — Crestline invoice variance (from Dana Whitfield, Jul 13)

This draft was prepared for your review. No messages were sent.

— Workspace Assistant
